about: Scrub trough modelled as a generic product: stainless apron, rim, end walls, sloped trough floor, upstand with capping, per bay a wall spout, sensor window, TMV access panel, knee paddle and waste. Drawn at 2 bays with CW/HW/waste arrayed per bay; 1-bay and 3-bay share the geometry until bay count drives it. Reference: query: scrub trough theatre plumbing fixtures hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=scrub+trough+theatre+plumbing+fixtures+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
